chu_de: CHI THI #4 UU TIEN: MOT con mau di het day chuyen
noi_dung:
CHI THI #4 (cloud->nha) UU TIEN - doi THU TU cua #1-#3, khong them viec. Da day 40dd6d0 (doc dau CLAUDE.md).

2. Lenh that: tab History cua 2196457 -> luu fixture, day len git (1 trang / 3-5 giay). Cloud viet adapter sau khi thay mau.
3. b nc cc boc_lich_su (tham so, gio lech, dieu kien vao) -> b nc cc thu_luoi tren kham_pha.
